request.label: r3-plan-measured-time-amendment
command:
import math,sys
from pathlib import Path
from resources import atomic,identity
from task2r_advancing import read,require,verified
from task2r_run import balance

r=Path(sys.argv[1]); mp=Path(sys.argv[2]); out=Path(sys.argv[3])
matrix=read(mp)
ops=r/"operations"
labels=("r3-time-startup-1","r3-time-perturbed-1","r3-time-perturbed-2")
records=[ops/label/"receipt.json" for label in labels]
measured=[read(path)["result"] for path in records]
require(measured[0]["status"]=="PASS" and measured[1]["status"]=="FAIL"
        and measured[1]["child_elapsed_seconds"]>=650, "measured correction need is not bound")
start=read(r/"evidence/r3-time-startup-1.json")["timing"]
signed_path=r/"evidence/r3-time-perturbed-2.json"
signed=read(signed_path) if signed_path.exists() else None
signed_full=signed is not None and signed["status"]=="PASS"
compare=ops/"r3-quantify-coarse-startup/receipt.json"
audit=ops/"r3-audit-perturbed-recovered-bdf2/receipt.json"
compare_seconds=read(compare)["result"]["seconds"]
audit_seconds=read(audit)["result"]["seconds"]
require(0<compare_seconds and 0<audit_seconds, "missing analysis cost anchors")

def profile_cost(timing, steps):
    fixed=sum(timing[k] for k in ("construction_seconds","initialisation_seconds",
                                  "final_export_seconds","process_remainder_seconds"))
    return fixed+sum(timing["complete_step_seconds"][:2])+(steps-2)*timing["warm_step_mean_seconds"]

rows=[]
for level in matrix["levels"]:
    if level["steps"]<=4 or (level["label"]==labels[-1] and signed_full):
        continue
    if level["role"]=="startup":
        estimate=profile_cost(start,level["steps"])
        basis="Measured coarsest retained-inlet setup and warm mean."
    elif signed_full:
        estimate=profile_cost(signed["timing"],level["steps"])
        basis="Measured .01 signed setup and warm mean."
    else:
        estimate=level["estimated_elapsed_seconds"]
        basis="Frozen signed estimate from the accepted .04 step engines, plus separately itemized corrective work."
    rows.append(dict(label=level["label"],steps=level["steps"],estimate_seconds=estimate,
                     admitted_scope_estimate_seconds=math.ceil(1.25*estimate+120),basis=basis))
operations=sum(row["admitted_scope_estimate_seconds"] for row in rows)
details=dict(finite_difference_displacement_control=2250, common_time_comparisons=math.ceil(1.25*8*compare_seconds),
    equation_witnesses=math.ceil(1.25*5*audit_seconds),
    cold_branches=math.ceil(1.25*profile_cost(start,8)), stock_and_publication=650)
core=operations+details["finite_difference_displacement_control"]+details["common_time_comparisons"]+math.ceil(1.25*2*audit_seconds)
complete=operations+sum(details.values())
ledger=read(r/"accounting.json"); a=balance(ledger)
require(ledger["ceiling"]==108000 and ledger["protected_seconds"]==3600,"original R3 authority differs")
left=a["nonprotected_remaining"]+a["reserved_seconds"]
require(core <= left + 21600,"paired corrections and time screen exceed the one-time amendment cap")
need=complete if complete <= left+21600 else core
milestone=("Bounded signed linearization control, remaining nested runs, independent checks, restart and stock comparison"
           if need==complete else
           "Bounded signed linearization control and nested time suite with two independent endpoint audits")
extra=min(21600,max(0,math.ceil(need-left)+1400))
require(need>left and extra>0, "remaining measured work fits the original parent ceiling")
data=dict(schema="WJH27R3TimeNeedV1",milestone=milestone,remaining_cost_seconds=need,
    complete_work_forecast_seconds=complete,additional_seconds=extra,
    measured_prefixes=[identity(p) for p in records],
    workload_basis=[identity(mp),identity(compare),identity(audit)],
    settled_prefix_status=[dict(label=label,status=v["status"],charged_seconds=v["seconds"])
                           for label,v in zip(labels,measured)],
    paired_remaining_run_estimates=rows,separate_postprocessing_estimates=details,
    balance_at_forecast=dict(charged=a["charged_seconds"],nonprotected=left),
    retry_reserve_seconds=extra+left-need,
    interpretation="One-time R3 charged allowances. Per-trajectory affordability and R4 admission remain separate.")
atomic(out,data)
print(data["remaining_cost_seconds"],data["additional_seconds"])
